panels.rationale: Article title attributes pili canaliculi to GAN. Caption and in-text state SEM shows grooving and polygonal shape as typical findings of pili canaliculi. Real patient hair ultrastructure showing characteristic GAN hair phenotype; mapped to kinky_curly_hair vocabulary term with precise SEM terms in proposed_findings.
panels.attribution_text: de Almeida Jr. et al. Pili canaliculi as manifestation of giant axonal neuropathy.. Anais brasileiros de dermatologia 2016. doi:10.1590/abd1806-4841.20164677. CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Figure 3.
panels.figure_caption: Scanning electron microscopy – high magnification showing grooving (arrows) and polygonal hair shape (x 700)
in_text_mentions: Scanning electron microscopy revealed longitudinal grooves on the surface of the hair at low magnification and a polygonal shape at higher magnification (Figures 2 and 3), typical findings of pili canaliculi.
